Type: velvet throw pillow, set of two
Use: decorating and resting on a sofa, bed or armchair; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, glam, modern
Materials: soft velvet fleece, plush filling
Colors: deep teal, cool blue-green
Shape: square, plain solid face, soft sheen, knife edges, plump and medium-sized
Feel: rich, soft, calm
Goes with: grey or cream sofas, brass accents, white walls, dark wood; modern or glam living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: AmazonBasics 2-Pack Velvet Fleece Decorative Throw Pillows - 18" Square, Deep Teal
product.description: Set of 2 decorative 18 by 18 inches square throw pillows for sofas, lounge chairs, beds, and more 100% polyester velvet fleece is soft to the touch and durable Match to your existing decor or use as a contrasting accent piece; easy to care for by machine or hand washing Comes in a vacuum-sealed pack; allow 24 hours to decompress Made in a Green factory with an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards
